headline: Extensive AI-driven attacks extend to mutual finance: "Hacking attempts may be far more numerous"
summary: AI-driven cyberattacks have extended from savings banks and capital companies to Saemaul Geumgo community credit cooperatives. Authorities are convening financial company heads, and banks are suspending vulnerable satellite sites.
why: Cyberattacks on financial institutions can disrupt services, expose customer data and raise compliance and security costs for lenders.
